source.title: Source contract
source.description: Synthetic partner, title, review and publication sources with key and relationship tests.
source.code:
version: 2

sources:
  - name: partner_platform
    description: Synthetic partner publishing inputs seeded for this portfolio reference.
    schema: main
    tables:
      - name: raw_partners
        description: One current row per synthetic partner.
        columns:
          - name: partner_id
            data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: raw_titles
        description: One current row per synthetic title.
        columns:
          - name: title_id
            data_tests: [unique, not_null]
          - name: partner_id
            data_tests:
              - not_null
              - relationships:
                  arguments:
                    to: source('partner_platform', 'raw_partners')
                    field: partner_id
      - name: raw_submissions
        description: One row per review attempt; a title may have several.
        columns:
          - name: submission_id
            data_tests: [unique, not_null]
          - name: title_id
            data_tests:
              - not_null
              - relationships:
                  arguments:
                    to: source('partner_platform', 'raw_titles')
                    field: title_id
      - name: raw_publications
        description: One storefront publication event per row.
        columns:
          - name: publication_id
            data_tests: [unique, not_null]
          - name: title_id
            data_tests:
              - not_null
              - relationships:
                  arguments:
                    to: source('partner_platform', 'raw_titles')
                    field: title_id

stage.title: Typed staging model
stage.description: One named place to cast times and standardise review status.
stage.code:
select
    cast(submission_id as varchar) as submission_id,
    cast(title_id as varchar) as title_id,
    cast(submitted_at as timestamp) as submitted_at,
    cast(reviewed_at as timestamp) as reviewed_at,
    lower(trim(status)) as status,
    cast(build_version as integer) as build_version
from {{ source('partner_platform', 'raw_submissions') }}

snapshot.title: Partner tier snapshot
snapshot.description: Timestamp strategy preserves partner-tier changes as history.

lifecycle.title: Submission lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Window ordering identifies each title's first attempt; the macro calculates review hours.
lifecycle.code:
select
    s.submission_id,
    s.title_id,
    t.partner_id,
    s.submitted_at,
    s.reviewed_at,
    s.status,
    s.build_version,
    row_number() over (
        partition by s.title_id
        order by s.submitted_at, s.submission_id
    ) as attempt_number,
    {{ review_hours('s.submitted_at', 's.reviewed_at') }} as review_hours
from {{ ref('stg_submissions') }} s
join {{ ref('stg_titles') }} t on s.title_id = t.title_id

title.title: One row per title
title.description: Submission and publication streams aggregate separately before joining, preventing fanout.
title.code:
with submissions as (
    select
        title_id,
        count(*) as submission_attempts,
        sum(case when reviewed_at is not null then 1 else 0 end) as reviewed_attempts,
        sum(coalesce(review_hours, 0)) as review_hours_total,
        min(submitted_at) as first_submitted_at,
        max(case when attempt_number = 1 and status = 'approved' then 1 else 0 end)
            as first_pass_approved,
        max(case when status = 'approved' then 1 else 0 end) as ever_approved
    from {{ ref('int_submission_lifecycle') }}
    group by title_id
), publications as (
    select
        title_id,
        count(distinct storefront_region) as published_regions,
        min(published_at) as first_published_at
    from {{ ref('stg_publications') }}
    group by title_id
)
select
    t.title_id,
    t.partner_id,
    t.planned_release_at,
    coalesce(s.submission_attempts, 0) as submission_attempts,
    coalesce(s.reviewed_attempts, 0) as reviewed_attempts,
    coalesce(s.review_hours_total, 0) as review_hours_total,
    coalesce(s.first_pass_approved, 0) as first_pass_approved,
    coalesce(s.ever_approved, 0) as ever_approved,
    coalesce(p.published_regions, 0) as published_regions,
    s.first_submitted_at,
    p.first_published_at,
    case when p.first_published_at is not null and s.first_submitted_at is not null
        then date_diff('day', s.first_submitted_at, p.first_published_at)
    end as publication_lead_days
from {{ ref('stg_titles') }} t
left join submissions s on t.title_id = s.title_id
left join publications p on t.title_id = p.title_id

fact.title: Submission fact
fact.description: A review-attempt grain for flexible downstream analysis.
fact.code:
select
    submission_id,
    title_id,
    partner_id,
    submitted_at,
    reviewed_at,
    status,
    build_version,
    attempt_number,
    review_hours
from {{ ref('int_submission_lifecycle') }}

dimension.title: Partner dimension
dimension.description: A partner key with business-friendly attributes.
dimension.code:
select partner_id, partner_name, region, partner_tier
from {{ ref('stg_partners') }}

mart.title: Partner publishing mart
mart.description: Curated partner-level measures, with explicit denominators.
mart.code:
select
    p.partner_id,
    p.partner_name,
    p.region,
    sum(case when o.submission_attempts > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as titles_submitted,
    sum(o.first_pass_approved) as first_pass_approved_titles,
    sum(case when o.published_regions > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as titles_published,
    sum(o.published_regions) as published_storefront_regions,
    sum(o.submission_attempts) as submission_attempts,
    sum(o.reviewed_attempts) as reviewed_attempts,
    sum(o.review_hours_total) as review_hours_total,
    round(100.0 * sum(o.first_pass_approved)
        / nullif(sum(case when o.submission_attempts > 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0), 1)
        as first_pass_approval_pct,
    round(sum(o.review_hours_total) / nullif(sum(o.reviewed_attempts), 0), 1)
        as avg_review_hours,
    round(avg(o.publication_lead_days), 1) as avg_publication_lead_days
from {{ ref('dim_partner') }} p
join {{ ref('int_title_outcomes') }} o on p.partner_id = o.partner_id
group by p.partner_id, p.partner_name, p.region

semantic.title: Metric contract
semantic.description: Versioned definitions and evidence requirements; a portfolio contract, not a deployed service.
semantic.code:
# Portfolio metric contract. This file documents business meaning; it is not
# presented as a deployed dbt Semantic Layer service.
version: 1
domain: synthetic_partner_publishing
owner: partner_analytics_portfolio
grain: partner_id
source_model: mart_partner_publishing
metrics:
  first_pass_approval_rate:
    label: First-pass approval rate
    expression: first_pass_approved_titles / titles_submitted
    display: percentage
    meaning: Share of submitted titles approved on their first review attempt.
    exclusions: Titles with no submission.
  average_review_hours:
    label: Average review hours
    expression: sum(review_hours_total) / sum(reviewed_attempts)
    display: hours
    meaning: Mean elapsed hours per reviewed submission attempt.
  published_titles:
    label: Published titles
    expression: titles_published
    display: count
    meaning: Distinct titles with at least one publication event.
policy:
  partner_scope: Bind row access to the caller's authorised partner IDs before querying.
evidence:
  - metric_version
  - source_freshness
  - dbt_test_status
  - source_to_mart_lineage

tests.title: Fanout assertion
tests.description: A singular dbt test fails if the one-row-per-title model changes its grain.
tests.code:
select
    (select count(*) from {{ ref('stg_titles') }}) as source_titles,
    (select count(*) from {{ ref('int_title_outcomes') }}) as outcome_titles
where source_titles <> outcome_titles

exposure.title: Dashboard exposure
exposure.description: The dbt exposure links a proposed partner dashboard to its upstream mart.
exposure.code:
version: 2

models:
  - name: dim_partner
    description: One row per partner; a synthetic current-state dimension.
    columns:
      - name: partner_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
  - name: dim_title
    description: One row per game or content title.
    columns:
      - name: title_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: partner_id
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('dim_partner')
                field: partner_id
  - name: fct_submission
    description: One row per publishing review attempt.
    columns:
      - name: submission_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: title_id
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('dim_title')
                field: title_id
      - name: status
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: ['approved', 'rejected', 'pending']
  - name: mart_partner_publishing
    description: Partner-level publishing health. All title outcomes are combined at title grain before this aggregation.
    columns:
      - name: partner_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: first_pass_approval_pct
        description: Approved on attempt one divided by titles with at least one submission, multiplied by 100.
      - name: avg_review_hours
        description: Total review hours divided by reviewed attempts.
      - name: avg_publication_lead_days
        description: Average days from first submission to first publication among published titles.

exposures:
  - name: partner_release_health
    label: Partner release health (synthetic portfolio example)
    type: dashboard
    maturity: low
    description: A possible partner operations dashboard using the governed publishing mart; no PlayStation dashboard has been deployed.
    depends_on:
      - ref('mart_partner_publishing')
    owner:
      name: VIM portfolio example
      email: portfolio@example.invalid

ci.title: Build on every change
ci.description: GitHub Actions runs dbt build and checks generated site evidence.
ci.code:
name: Verify NEXUS partner analytics

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  dbt-reference:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install dbt and DuckDB adapter
        run: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Build and test synthetic data product
        run: dbt build --profiles-dir .
      - name: Verify site evidence matches working code
        run: |
          python scripts/export_metrics.py --check
          python scripts/build_snippets.py --check
